Privacy Terms Delete account

Delete your SinLines account

You can ask for your account to be deleted here, or in the app: Profile > Delete account.

What happens

Your data is kept for 7 days in case you change your mind. Log in within 7 days to cancel. After that it's permanently deleted.

  • Deleted: your account (username, birth year and any parent's email), your place in books, your reading days and streak, your saved lines and your choices.
  • Kept without your account: feedback you sent us and sinLes counts (which lines were viewed or saved), with nothing linking them to you.
  • Backups: copies in our encrypted weekly backups expire within 90 days.
  • On your phone: books you added, My words and your settings stay until you delete the app.

Your username and password go to our server over an encrypted connection (HTTPS) only to check it's you. We never keep or log your password. Questions? Write to sinlines.read@gmail.com.
